records.destination: Richland Parish, Louisiana for the Meta data center
records.source_title: Large Power Transformer Transported from Kansas to Louisiana for Meta Data Center

records.semantics: The transport is source-backed; transformer rating, manufacturer and exact event date are not asserted because the public post does not provide them.

records.evidence_quote: Hyperscale data center — Rayville, LA · Q4 2025; Campus substation unit delivered to the utility interconnect schedule.
records.linkage_basis: Supplier project page identifies a hyperscale data-center campus in Rayville, Louisiana; the Epoch Meta Hyperion record is the corresponding Richland Parish site. The public supplier page does not expose a parcel-level identifier.
records.semantics: Source-backed delivery record. The public source gives a three-stage 15/20/25 MVA rating and 34.5/13.8 kV voltage classes; it does not identify a manufacturer or exact parcel.
